==English== ===Etymology=== From {{af|en|craze|-y}}, akin to being "crazed up". Compare {{m|en|crack up|cracked up|t=suffered a mental breakdown; be insane}}, {{m|en|crackpot}}. Compare typologically {{m+|ru|чо́кнутый}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|krāzē}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈkɹeɪ.zi/|a=RP,GA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-crazy.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkɹæɪ.zi/|a=AU}} * {{rhymes|en|eɪzi|s=2}} * {{hyph|en|cra|zy}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj|er}} # Of [[unsound]] [[mind]]; [[insane]]; [[demented]]. {{defdate|from 17th c.}} #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:insane}} #: {{ux|en|His ideas were both frightening and '''crazy'''.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1828|author=James Hogg|title=Mary Burnet |passage=Those words appearing to be merely the ravings of superannuation, they were not regarded; but when no other traces of Mary could be found, old Andrew went up to consult this '''crazy''' dame once more, but he was not able to bring any such thing to her recollection.}} #* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=5|passage=Of all the queer collections of humans outside of a '''crazy''' asylum, it seemed to me this sanitarium was the cup winner. {{...}} When you're well enough off so's you don't have to fret about anything but your heft or your diseases you begin to get queer, I suppose.}} #* {{quote-song|en|author=w:Billy Joel|authorlabel=no|title=w:You May Be Right|album={{w|Glass Houses (album)|Glass Houses}}|date=1980-03-07|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ilsv0C1-aBw|text=Now think of all the years you tried to

If I'm '''crazy''' then it's true

And you wouldn't want me any other way}} #* {{quote-song|en|title=w:Sweet but Psycho|year=2018|author=w:Ava Max; w:Madison Love; w:Tix; w:Cook Classics; w:Cirkut|album={{w|Heaven & Hell (Ava Max album)|Heaven & Hell}}|artist=Ava Max|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXBHCQYxwr0|text=Grab-a-cop-gun kinda '''crazy''' / She's poison but tasty / Yeah, people say "Run, don't walk, away"}} # [[out of control|Out of control]]. #: {{ux|en|When she gets on the motorcycle she goes '''crazy'''.}} # Very [[excited]] or [[enthusiastic]]. #: {{ux|en|He went '''crazy''' when he won.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1864|author=R.
